verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry and usage tracking is a fair question for a desktop operating system, so the axis applies. The evidence pack has no documentation of a telemetry or usage-data opt-out control. The only related item is a generic marketing claim that Ubuntu 'prioritizes user privacy', which does not describe an opt-out mechanism.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
